summary: All 97 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all six computations reproduced. All 33 selected effects agreed in direction, and 10 passed animal-level FDR < 0.05. The corrected proposal records that both publications specify a 600-UMI minimum, that 72 registered hypothalamic profiles from young mouse FY1 fall below it, and that the author fold changes include a 0.01 TPM offset. The proposal passed validation and retains needs_author_contact.
openIssues: The final Table S5 cohort still requires author confirmation of the UMI counts used for filtering and a barcode-level map of retained profiles and their regional assignments.
The published spatial-profile statistics do not establish animal-level P-value or FDR agreement.
